decisions.reason: While the citrus harvesting crate uses our crate know-how, its crop-specific niche and its disappearance from the website after 2019 suggest limited scalable learning and a weaker case than broader platform products for continuing resource commitment.

The foldable large container sits very close to our core container engineering base and offers broad cross-sector application, so even with lower recent visibility we would more likely refine and retain the line than withdraw it.

A medium-duty rackable pallet remains well within our established pallet capabilities and customer needs, making it a product we can continue to improve and commercialize using existing knowledge and manufacturing assets.

Although the pallet with load retainers builds on our pallet platform, it looks like a narrower feature variant whose learning can be absorbed into the core range, so rationalizing it as a standalone product is slightly more likely than keeping it.
